source_title: Entertainment Tiger Shroff Firing Case: 2 Arrested As Shooters Allegedly Reveal Plan To Spread Fear In Bollywood
source_excerpt:
The two men arrested in connection with the firing incident involving Tiger Shroff’s car allegedly told investigators that they intended to intimidate the actor and create fear in Bollywood, rather than kill him. According to Mumbai Crime Branch sources, reported by IANS the claims are being examined as investigators probe the alleged conspiracy behind the incident.
The accused, identified as Phool Singh and Rehan Singh, reportedly stayed at a hotel in Andheri East for five days while using false identities, according to reports by IANS .

According to Mumbai Crime Branch sources cited by IANS, the arrested men allegedly said their objective was to frighten Tiger Shroff and send a message across the Hindi film industry. Investigators are examining their statements as part of the ongoing probe into the firing incident and the alleged conspiracy.

The reported claim that the men did not intend to kill the actor remains part of the investigation and has not been independently established.

Phool Singh and Rehan Singh reportedly checked into RR Residency in Andheri East on the 14th and left on the 18th. Hotel staff member Dheeraj Yadav told IANS that the two men stayed at the property for five days.
He said, “They checked in on the 14th around 11:00 AM. On the 18th, around 4:10 PM, they left. There were two of them... They had two bags and some clothes in a plastic bag, that's all...”
